Fixed {data-navmenu="Parameters"}
================================================================================

Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r, results = "asis"}
groups <- tinyAM:::.fixed_parameter_groups(fixed_par)
for (category in names(groups)) {
  parameter_group <- groups[[category]]
  rendered <- knitr::knit_child(text = c(
    paste("###", category), "",
    "```{r}",
    'd <- plot_rows(parameter_group, "est")',
    "if (nrow(d)) plot_par(d, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols) else plotly::plot_ly()",
    "```", ""), quiet = TRUE)
  cat(rendered, sep = "\n")
}
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
for (component in c("F", "N", "M")) {
  process_sd <- pop[[paste0("sd_", component)]]
  if (is.null(process_sd)) next
  process_sd <- process_sd[!duplicated(process_sd[c("model", "age")]), ]
  rendered <- knitr::knit_child(text = c(
    paste("###", component, "process SD"), "",
    "```{r}",
    'plot_report(plot_rows(process_sd, "est"), x = ~age, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Process SD")',
    "```", ""), quiet = TRUE)
  cat(rendered, sep = "\n")
}
```
